notes.title: New Weapon and More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43690612/225984cdc035638cd39e3e9f220d30b6ea2552d1.png[/img]

The latest update of the Fall of Gods Demo introduces another new weapon and new combat features!

[h2][b]New Weapon: Dagger[/b][/h2]
Designed as a counterpart to the slow and heavy Great Sword, the Dagger is a fast weapon that is effective against single targets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43690612/83de3ffa1d1c0c2ab793d04637f5f7a1b7c8de06.png[/img]

[h2][b]Improved Ultimate Weapon Mode[/b][/h2]
Once activated, the Ultimate Weapon Mode (UWM) now stays active even after switching weapons, but only until you run out of mana!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43690612/0a6102b4a723124e5ef0ad07772ed2c5895e10a7.png[/img]

[h2][b]New UWM control scheme[/b][/h2]
Prior to this update, the UWM was automatically activated once the weapon's meter was filled and the player pressed the corresponding weapon switching button.

To give the player more control, we changed this behaviour by introducing dedicated buttons (LB and RB) to activate the UWM.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43690612/d566e3571ca70517b4548616f739d30f87a26cce.png[/img]

[h2][b]Jump Cancel and Dodge Cancel[/b][/h2]
[b]Jump Cancel:[/b] Press space after hitting an enemy in the air to cancel into a jump animation and start another combo!

[b]Dodge Cancel:[/b] Cancel the dodge roll animation into attacks after approaching an enemy!

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
- Nerfed Horus spin attack range and damage
- Nerfed player sword air special attack range
- Increased damage of fire meteor attack
- Increased damage of (fire) great sword special attack

[h2]More improvements:[/h2]
- Changed player VFX and HUD colors to be better distinguishable from other effects
- Added a "Restart Run" button
- Improved Camera
- Improved Auto-Aim
- Improved enemy AI
- Weapon is now hidden during dodge roll
- Added camera shake to great sword air special attack
- Added a stop running animation

[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
- Fixed a bug that made Horus glitch through the ground when going to phase 2
- Fixed a bug that let the player do a nearly infinite amount of rapid air dashes 
- Fixed some sounds being delayed when they were played for the first time
- Fixed sand fall locations in Horus room
- Fixed Dart Mage not reloading when hit with an air attack
- Fixed some broken item pickup visuals
- Fixed enemies being stuck in the air sometimes

notes.title: Big Combat Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43690612/de870649edacc3f2cbbbf37f7087492c5ba763af.png[/img]

The latest update of the Fall of Gods Demo introduces a greatly improved combat system. Get ready for [b]aerial combat[/b], [b]multiple weapons[/b] and the new[b] ultimate weapon mode[/b]!

[h2][b]New Weapon: Great sword[/b][/h2]
Introducing the great sword, a slow but heavy hitter! Switch weapons at any time to perform devastating combos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43690612/11397ebf315b31352557b3833e4c9a7f6b43337f.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Aerial Combat[/b][/h2]
Launch your enemies into the air and smack them down to the ground! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43690612/0e53488777edfdd7aa99fcca5b6141c0cfb6370a.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Ultimate Weapon Mode[/b][/h2]
Fulfill conditions to activate the great sword's ultimate mode und unlock the fire sword!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43690612/fc4c6d019c1140d7b0717856a32843f02b518eb0.jpg[/img]

[h2]More improvements:[/h2]
- Improved hit detection system (more precise and FPS independent)
- Better readability of enemy attacks
- Better readability of player combo progression
- Sword is now attached to player's back
- Improved responsiveness by allowing the player to dodge roll at any time
- Improved HUD
- Improved trap models and VFX
- Improved hitbox of Horus shockwave attack
- Improved map to show the start room
- Improved vase destruction when using dodge roll
- New vase destruction VFX
- Camera options (camera lag and boss target locking)

[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
- Player sometimes not being able to move after using air dash
- FPS permanently decreased by destroyed vases
- Heal Item VFX wrongly respawning
- Horus teleporting into regions where he should not go
- Streaming Level Loading Lag
- Wrong sound setting names
- Esc button not working in all menus

notes.title: Fall of Gods Tech Demo now available!
notes.content:
After two years of development, we are very excited to announce the release of the Fall of Gods Tech Demo! 

We're still in a very early stage of development and there is still a lot of work to be done. But we would like to share our current progress with you in the form of this Demo and in return would love to hear your feedback!

Go check it out for free!
